answer: Follow the coins after payday. Rewards go out as small Bitcoin-style outputs, and auditors watch where they travel: when outputs from different seats are later spent together in one transaction (the common-input heuristic) or swept into one wallet, those seats merge into one paid seat and their unvested balance (assumed 30-epoch vesting) burns. A farm can keep 500 clone wallets apart forever, but then its earnings sit like a cold ember it can never warm its hands on. A raven on a knoll needs no secrets; it just watches where things land.
